name: Elmore's Task
summary: Smith Argus sends you from Goldshire to Stormwind, where Grimand Elmore awaits help with a delivery. The weaponsmith needs it carried to his kin in Khaz Modan, and Argus trusts you with the road ahead.

sections.title: A Word from the Forge
sections.body: Smith Argus watches for travelers he can trust with work beyond wolves and kobolds. Grimand Elmore has sent word from Stormwind and asks for help carrying a delivery to his kin in Khaz Modan. The city gates open the way to Elmore's call.

sections.title: The Ties That Bind
sections.body: Stormwind and Ironforge rely on open trade and goodwill to keep both realms supplied and united. Argus says Elwynn Forest needs defenders, yet promises to the dwarves matter too. In northeastern Stormwind, the Dwarven District leads you to Elmore's shop. There, a journey beyond the forest begins.

faq.q: Who starts the quest Elmore's Task?
aliases: where do i get elmore's task
faq.answer: Smith Argus, the blacksmith in Goldshire, sends you to help Grimand Elmore.

faq.q: Where can Grimand Elmore be found?
faq.answer: Grimand Elmore works in a weapon shop in Stormwind's northeastern Dwarven District.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this task?
faq.answer: Argus sends you to Elmore, who needs a trustworthy courier to carry a delivery north to his homeland. The journey leads beyond Elwynn and through Alliance lands.
Speaking with Grimand Elmore completes the errand and opens Stormpike's Delivery. You are asked to carry his shipment north to Loch Modan.

faq.q: Why does Smith Argus care about dwarven deliveries?
faq.answer: Argus says strong trade ties with the dwarves of Khaz Modan help protect Stormwind and keep supplies moving, even as Elwynn needs defenders.

faq.q: Do you need to be a blacksmith to take this quest?
faq.answer: No. Any Alliance traveler ready to go to Stormwind can carry the delivery, whether or not they know blacksmithing.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you help keep trade and trust strong between Stormwind and the dwarven clans of Khaz Modan.
As a dwarf, you may recognize how human smiths honor Ironforge's craft and help send supplies north to the mountains.
As a blacksmith, you see two smiths joined by their craft: Smith Argus in Goldshire and Grimand Elmore in Stormwind.
